name: token-station-icon
source_reference: Token Station product semantics, current project icon, user-supplied small agent-icon style reference, and generated concept exploration
brief: A restrained local AI routing-station mark: a blue token enters a warm-white station tile through a dark diagonal channel and leaves as an amber routed token. Flat near-black stage, no text or third-party marks.

semantic_review.basis: original task-specific mark with no external brand identity
semantic_review.notes: Preserve the compact rounded-diamond station tile and diagonal handoff channel; do not drift into a letter, chain link, Gemini-like sparkle, sync mark, or node network.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: preserve the original Token Station switch-track metaphor, strong small-size silhouette, and two restrained brand accents
must_preserve: one broad near-black diagonal handoff channel rendered as an opaque overlay
one cobalt circular entry token and one amber rounded-square routed token
large quiet negative space around the centered mark
must_not_add: text, letters, terminal prompt, model logo, shield, arrows, Wi-Fi rings, sync circle, chain link, sparkle, or node network
bevel, glow, shadow, highlight, texture, frame, or PNG foreground fallback

spec_constraints: one clean rotated rounded-square SVG primitive
soft corners and balanced diagonal mass
no stroke or material helper geometry
one broad opaque background-colored rounded rectangle

acceptance_checks: the mark remains distinct from a letter, chain link, or sparkle at 32px
all foreground components are clean SVG assets
package verification has no svg_material_warnings or package warnings
